title: [Feature Request] Host .vsix file for Claude Code VSCode extension on Github?
body: Would it be possible to make the .vsix file for the Claude Code VSCode extension available for download on Github (or somewhere else)? This would facilitate installation by those using other VSCode-compatible IDEs (e.g., [Positron](https://github.com/posit-dev/positron), a VSCode fork) to install it. Thanks!
author: coussens

top_comments.author: igorkofman
top_comments.body:
Does Positron install a CLI that can be used to install the extension? 
Perhaps you could expose an environment variable with the cli tool to use, something like CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_IDE_CLI and we can call that with the --install-extension command

top_comments.author: igorkofman
top_comments.body:
It should auto-install if you run Claude Code inside Cursor terminal.
